parameters.title: Machine learning parameter sets.
parameters.label: Manage the machine learning parameter sets (raw, preset and custom) in the ml_setting schema.

parameters.title: Create the per-indicator rows of the transformation and standardisation parameter sets and placeholder plot symbols
parameters.label: For every indicator in observation_utility.indicator, write a row in each (not frozen) transformation / standardisation parameter set, with the value of the set template (by indicator name or alias) or linear / no standardisation, and a grey placeholder plot symbol for indicators without one. Runs automatically after manage_indicator.

parameter.hint: Families to sync: transformation, standardisation, plot_symbol (empty = all three). plot_symbol adds a grey placeholder symbol (needs_review) for indicators without one.
Rewrite existing per-indicator rows from the set templates (false = only add rows for indicators that have none).

parameters.title: Create a custom parameter set
parameters.label: Copies an existing parameter set (base_set), applies the changes in a settings JSON file and saves the result as a custom set. An existing custom name gets a new version; raw and preset names are reserved.

parameter.hint: Family of the set: transformation, standardisation, filter, multi_filter, selector, regressor, spectra_plot, plot_symbol, plot_layout.
Name of the custom set (lowercase; not none or default, no @).
Set to start from: name[@version], default (= standard) or none.
JSON file with the changes, same shape as the default settings files (e.g. {"transformation": {"c-org": {"log": true}}}); path relative to the project root. Empty = copy of the base set.
Short description of the set (empty = based on <base set>).

parameters.title: List the parameter sets
parameters.label: Prints family, name, version, category, frozen, creator and abstract of the parameter sets.
